Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines 
 the equipment inspection checklist I1, to be carried out every three 
 months as indicated by M3 in the title block.
The Control & 
 Protection of Feed Water Pump consist of:
Release 
 and Protection feed water pumps:
a- Level Switches
b- Flow Transmitters.
c- RTDs
d- Sol. Valves of Minimum Flow
e- Limit Switches on Suction and discharge Valves
f- Back rotation device
g- Pressure switches.
h- Local gauge.
Control of main 
 flow valves
a- Position transmitters
b- Flow transmitters
c- Limit switch & torque switch
For testing protection system perform the following:
Each protection loop have ( sensor, switch, software logic, I/O electronic 
 modules and final control element test )
The first draft initiated by 
 eng. Mohamed Gomaa, tested by eng Waled Wahba, revised by EDEPC quality control 
 eng. Abdel-Moniem 
 Al-Emam, accepted by eng. Ibrahim El-Sayed: general manager, and 
 approved by eng. Mokhtar Abd El-Latef Mady: Head Sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
 inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by eng. Mervat Ez-Elden: EDEPC head sector of inspection & 
 quality control's sector.
Safety 
Precautions
A work order must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be qualified
 and carry the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, anti static 
 hand probe to avoid electrical shock etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
The pump must be off
Tools 
and Equipment
Digital multi-meter.
Screw driver kit, manual tools.
Oil spry cleaner & Teflon roll.
Current injector.
Spanner.
Work to 
be Carried Out
Preparation
Obtain a copy of ( limit switches, torque switches, pressure switches , RTD 
 transmitter, level transmitter, flow transmitter, junction box ) maintenance manuals.
Obtain a copy of schematic loop wiring diagram for any protection signal, and 
 data sheet.
feed water pumps
Check pressure switches of each pump and make maintenance for it ( clean micro 
 switch, recalibrate ).
Check flow transmitter for each pump and make maintenance for it (clean & function 
 check, recalibration ).
Check RTD on each pump ( measuring temperature, check the signal )
Check local gauge for right calibration.
Check limit switch & torque switch for each valves and make maintenance for it 
 (clean & function check).
Solenoid valves
Clean moving parts for sol 
 .valves.
Check the "O" ring.
Measure resistance for coil.
Check wiring up to junction box.
Check limit switches for valves.
Check signal up to ovation screen and output command from ovation control.
Check time for opening and closing valves.
